notes.title: ROBO CATCHER ZERO is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

We're happy to announce that [b][i]Robo Catcher Zero,[/i][/b] the demo of our upcoming game [i][b]Robo Catcher[/b][/i], is now available to download! 
Available in French, English, Italian, Spanish and Chinese.


The demo is part of the Creature Collector Steam Festival so you'll be able to play it from today to the 19th May.


Enjoy and don't hesitate to tell us what you think!


Cheers,
The Pixel Fortress Team
